verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS creative platform like Kling AI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, tracking controls, or any opt-out setting. The cited material covers generation features, pricing, API authentication, and the changelog only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
